text:
maria.g: quick q — are we enforcing TLS 1.3 on Redwood Private by default? I noticed the package nginx config still mentions TLSv1.2 in onboarding docs.
andrew.k: we default to TLS1.3 for outbound connections from the control plane. inbound for Private depends on the local nginx config we ship. we left TLSv1.2 enabled for compat.
sarah.m: for the vpc/on-prem package we ship `ssl_protocols TLSv1.3 TLSv1.2;` so customers can opt to disable 1.2. there is an env var `REDWOOD_TLS_MIN` they can set.
jess.l: logging sanity check: are we currently recording cert serials / issuer CNs in access logs or traces? that's a PCI/PII risk for some customers.
andrew.k: good call. current handshake metadata includes `tls.subject_cn` and `tls.issuer_cn` in fluentd events. serial is also captured for the handshake in rare cases.
maria.g: can we stop logging those fields or at least hash them? redaction needed for PCI audits.
andrew.k: short-term: we can redact at fluentd via filter plugin and replace values with a SHA256 hash. long-term: remove them from access schema entirely. i'll open a PR.
oncall-bot: deploy window scheduled: fluentd redact change — 2026-03-20 02:00-03:00 UTC (rolling)
jess.l: who owns key rotation responsibility for Private deployments? customer key vs platform-managed key? need to put ownership in the PCI checklist.
sarah.m: ownership model: customer-managed KMS/HSM -> customer rotates. if they choose Redwood-managed keys (optional) we rotate on our schedule. Dedicated/Hosted have Redwood-managed defaults.
andrew.k: specifics: Hosted -> Redwood CMKs, rotation quarterly. Dedicated -> default Redwood quarterly unless customer opts in to BYOK. Private -> default is customer-managed; if they accept Redwood keys we run monthly rotations by default.
maria.g: can you paste the policy snippet here so I can reference it in the checklist?
andrew.k: sure: ```- Hosted: Redwood KMS (rotation quarterly) - Dedicated: default Redwood KMS (quarterly) unless BYOK - Private: customer-managed recommended; if Redwood-managed keys used, rotation monthly and audit logs retained 1y```
jess.l: i'll add an item to the PCI prep checklist: "confirm no cert serials / issuer CN in logs or they are redacted/hashed; verify key ownership is documented per deployment."
andrew.k: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/+/b1234 — fluentd: redact `tls.subject_cn`, `tls.issuer_cn`, `tls.serial` -> hash, and drop full cert blob from access events.
maria.g: also need to ensure telemetry/traces don't carry cert fields. cc @telemetry-bot
telemetry-bot: acknowledged. we'll scrub `tls.*` fields at ingestion and add a verification check to the trace linter.
maria.g: perfect. once PR is merged and deploy goes green i'll mark the PCI checklist entry done. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
